IShoppingCategory.description:
Category node in the shopping mall taxonomy hierarchy. Each node is part of a shopping_category_tree and may be nested under a parent (or be a root). Fields include unique business code, display name, parent reference, display order, and optional documentation. Soft-deletable, all changes timestamped for audit.

Relations:
- 'category_tree_id' points to the taxonomy/category tree (shopping_category_trees).
- 'parent_id' links to another category node if nested.
- Included 'sort_order' for sibling display and navigation control.
- 'deleted_at' used for soft-deletion/archiving.

For UI navigation, category trees, and product assignment/business logic.

category_tree_id.description: Foreign key (UUID) of the category tree (shopping_category_trees.id) to which this new category will belong. Required to specify the taxonomy for placement.

category_code.description: Unique and URL-friendly code (always lowercase) used to identify this category within the target tree. Must not duplicate any existing code in the same tree. Used for API lookups, navigation, and import/export flows.

category_name.description: Display name to show for the category in front-end navigation, admin UI, and selection widgets. Must be non-empty and meaningful for catalog users.

oneOf.description: (Optional) Parent category UUID if this category is nested under another. Set to null or omit for root-level nodes.

parent_id.description: Optional parent category node ID (UUID) if this category is a child of another node. Null or omitted for root categories. Used for hierarchical taxonomy setup.

sort_order.description: Integer value indicating where this node should appear among siblings under the same parent/root. Lower numbers are displayed first (e.g., 1 = top, 2, 3, ...).

oneOf.description: Optional, free-form documentation or display notes for the category node, used in admin interfaces.

description.description: Optional text documentation describing the business logic, purpose, or special display hints for this category node.

IShoppingCategory.ICreate.description: DTO for creating a new category node in a specific category tree. Used only by admin actors for catalog/taxonomy management. Requires unique category_code (per tree), display name, and sort_order. Supports optional parent_id for nesting within an existing category. Accepts optional documentation (description). Must match fields defined by 'shopping_categories' model (excluding system-managed IDs and timestamps, which are auto-generated). See business rules for unique constraint and parent/child logic.

category_name.description: New display name for the category node. Must remain unique among siblings in the same category tree and adhere to business rules outlined for catalog management (e.g., maximum length, no duplication within the same level). Updates the 'category_name' column in the shopping_categories table. When updating, platform validates uniqueness within the sibling set.

sort_order.description: Zero-based integer specifying the display position among sibling categories in its parent category node. Changing this reorders the node in catalog navigation and must not break business hierarchy constraints (e.g., sort_order uniqueness within siblings).

description.description: Optional human-readable description or managed documentation for the category node. When present, it should detail the business purpose, catalog context, or usage restrictions (e.g., restrictions on assignments to non-leaf categories). Used for admin and UI reference. If not provided, existing value is retained.

parent_id.description: Optional new parent category for this node (UUID from shopping_categories). Changing parent_id reassigns the node's location in the category tree. Must belong to the same category tree, not create cycles, and satisfy depth or hierarchy business rules. If omitted, the category remains at its current position.

IShoppingCategory.IUpdate.description:
Admin-side Data Transfer Object used to update an existing category node in a shopping mall category taxonomy (shopping_categories table). Fields supported for update include display name, sibling position sorting, admin/business description, and parent hierarchy reassignment, while all updates are subject to strict business rules:
- category_name must remain unique among siblings in the same tree
- sort_order must be a unique integer within its sibling group
- parent_id (if set) must remain in the same tree and not create cycles or violate hierarchy constraints
- Updates are thoroughly validated for hierarchical integrity, uniqueness, audit logging, and compliance with taxonomy governance policies
- Intended only for admin operations; all writes are fully audited
All property updates are validated to ensure conformity with business constraints for platform taxonomy management.

id.description: Unique identifier for the system log entry (primary key of shopping_system_logs table). Used for traceability and lookups in log diagnostics.

event_time.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) indicating when the log event occurred. Set by logging infrastructure at event generation. Critical for audit context and event sequencing.

log_level.description: Severity or log level for the event (examples include 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'fatal'). Reflects log significance for platform monitoring and support prioritization.

event_type.description: Category or type of the log event (e.g., 'system_init', 'migration', 'admin_action', 'error', 'scheduled_task'). Used for backend automation, diagnostics, and trace filtering.

event_source.description: Source/origin indicating the module, subsystem, or service generating this event (e.g., 'order_service', 'cron_worker'). Enables targeted investigation by platform teams.

message.description: Single-line summary or primary message for the log event, designed for operator readability in dashboards and alert feeds.

details.description: Optional extended metadata, details, or stack trace associated with the log event. May be JSON-encoded or raw text, based on subsystem conventions. Often contains diagnostic context, input parameters, or structured debugging information; should be used cautiously to avoid PII or secrets exposure.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the log row was persisted in the platform's durable store. ISO 8601 UTC, typically matches event_time but may differ for bulk ingestion or delayed writes.

IShoppingSystemLog.description:
Detailed record of a single system log entry, as registered in the shopping_system_logs table. Used for tracking all platform-level events, errors, migrations, and administrative actions in the e-commerce platform. All fields are intended for operator/admin/DevOps use:
- Field 'details' may contain JSON-encoded diagnostic metadata, stack trace, or business context, and should never expose plain secrets or sensitive PII; use care when ingesting and displaying
- All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC for system-wide correlation
- Intended for backend observability, compliance, root-cause analysis, and performance investigations
Access to these records MUST be limited to authorized admin and operator roles due to possible exposure of sensitive system state and diagnostics. Used in audit trail reconstruction, security forensics, and business continuity reviews.

IShoppingCustomer.IRequest.description: Request parameters for filtered, paginated customer search. Used by admin/internal backends for customer list UIs and analytics. Supports standard search and paging logic. Does not directly expose restricted/sensitive customer fields.

email.description: Email address of the customer (used for login and contact). Uniquely identifies the customer. As per shopping_customers.email.

name.description: Customer's full display name, shown in order details and for personalization. From shopping_customers.name.

phone.description: Primary customer contact phone, formatted to local standard. Used for order notifications and delivery contacts. From shopping_customers.phone.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for last account data update. Reflects profile/contact/modification events.

IShoppingCustomer.description: Detailed information about a customer account, as stored in shopping_customers table. Contains profile data, contact, active/inactive status, and audit timestamps. Sensitive fields like password_hash are omitted as per security policy.

IShoppingCustomer.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for ShoppingCustomer entity presenting a lightweight, non-sensitive view for actor referencing, compliance reporting, or order/review context (list displays, audit, references only—not editing or direct account detail use). Extends minimal fields with active/deleted state and created timestamp for compliance ledger, business audit, and list UI uses.

**Fields:**
- id: Unique business/account identifier (UUID)
- email: Customer's unique business/login email
- name: Customer's display name (personalization/communication)
- is_active: Current enabled/disabled state of the account (suspension, lockout, or deleted actors will be false; shopping_customers.is_active)
- created_at: Timestamp for customer account creation (ISO 8601, compliance audit trace)
- deleted_at: Nullable—soft-deletion marker for GDPR, inactive account tracking, compliance reporting

id.description: Unique identifier of the customer who owns the cart. Follows shopping_customers.id.

name.description: Full display name of the customer.

email.description: Login/business email address used for shopping.

is_active.description: Account active state (shopping_customers.is_active). If false, account is suspended, deleted, or locked; used for UI display and compliance logic.

created_at.description: Timestamp of customer account creation (ISO 8601, shopping_customers.created_at). Important for business audit, analytics, or compliance reporting.

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp of the account for GDPR or business policy; if null, account is active. Sourced from shopping_customers.deleted_at.

name.description: Full display name of the customer for delivery and personalization. Sourced from the Prisma schema shopping_customers.name. Updateable only by the profile owner or admin, subject to non-empty and format validation. This field does not permit modification if soft-deleted.

phone.description: Primary contact phone for verification and delivery notifications. Derived from shopping_customers.phone in Prisma. Must be a valid phone number as per business or regional phone formats. Update requires authorization by customer or admin. Cannot be changed after account deletion.

is_active.description: Indicates if the customer account is active and allowed to log in. Based on shopping_customers.is_active from the Prisma schema. Only an admin may change this field. Customers cannot change this value directly; this field is optional for most update cases.

All updates are validated and audit-logged as per business rules. This definition is directly mapped from the shopping_customers table in the Prisma schema. Any attempt to modify restricted, immutable, or system-managed fields will result in a business error. Only platform admins or the owning customer can invoke this operation.

IShoppingSeller.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for shopping seller accounts. This type defines the updatable fields for the seller profile and business information. Fields correspond to the shopping_sellers table and allow admin- or seller-initiated modifications (except immutable identifiers, email uniqueness, and ownership fields). All updates are auditable. Only permitted attributes are included; ownership and system fields are excluded.

Fields:
- display_name: The seller’s public-facing name. Updatable by admin or seller; must be unique within business constraints.
- contact_phone: Seller’s main business contact number. Must be a valid phone number by E.164/local format.
- status: Seller account status. May include business logic such as pending, active, suspended, or rejected depending on admin workflow. Enum values must match those in the platform policy and shopping_sellers.status.
- updated_at: Last profile update timestamp. Optional; typically auto-managed.

Immutables: id, email, password_hash, created_at, deleted_at may not be edited through this DTO.

All fields optional to support partial updates per best practice.

display_name.description: Seller’s display/public name. Updatable by the seller or admin. Unique within business, 1–100 characters recommended. Maps to shopping_sellers.display_name.

contact_phone.description: Seller’s primary business contact phone. Updatable; must be a valid international or local phone number per compliance. Maps to shopping_sellers.contact_phone.

status.description: Seller account status. May be set to business values such as 'pending', 'active', 'suspended', 'rejected'. Strictly enforced; must match values in shopping_sellers.status. Updatable by admin for workflow or compliance.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last profile update. Optional; most systems auto-set this value. May be used for optimistic concurrency if set by client.

IShoppingSellerBusinessInfo.description:
Full business compliance, registration, and KYC credentials for a seller account in the shopping mall platform. Maps directly to shopping_seller_business_infos, and contains all required fields for KYC, settlements, compliance, and business registration. May be accessed by both seller and admin actors for onboarding, verification, payment settlement, and compliance review.

Fields:
- id: Primary key, UUID of the business info record.
- shopping_seller_id: FK to seller's primary key (UUID), strictly 1:1 relation. Used for compliance workflow.
- legal_entity_name: The official legal name on business registration documents.
- registration_number: National or regional business registration or tax ID, must be unique per regulator. Uniqueness is enforced.
- representative_name: Name of legal representative/owner per the business registry. Entity must be an individual or corporate.
- support_contact: Seller's public-facing or compliance support phone/email.
- bank_account_number: Settlement bank account for payouts; must conform to KYC requirements.
- created_at, updated_at: Audit timestamps for creation/modification.

Sensitive or regulated fields (like tax numbers, bank accounts) should be masked from non-authorized/non-admin actors.

May be updated by the owning seller or admin only (see IShoppingSellerBusinessInfo.IUpdate for update DTO).

Immutable: id, shopping_seller_id, created_at. All other fields mutable by authorized actors only.

id.description: Primary key of the business info record. Maps to shopping_seller_business_infos.id. Immutable.

shopping_seller_id.description: Strict foreign key to parent seller account. Must match shopping_sellers.id. Enforces 1:1 relation.

legal_entity_name.description: The legal name of the seller entity (KYC/registry name). Must match official documents. Up to 200 characters, required for business onboarding.

registration_number.description: Legal registration number/tax ID as per regional authority (unique, compliance-enforced). Bank settlements require this to be valid. Up to 100 characters.

representative_name.description: Official legal representative or owner name per compliance. Must match tax paperwork. Up to 100 characters.

support_contact.description: Public/business support phone/email for the seller. Must be valid and reachable. Up to 100 characters. Used for compliance notifications.

bank_account_number.description: Primary settlement bank account (must pass KYC/AML validation). Masked in API for non-admins. Up to 100 characters.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the business info entry was created. Maps to shopping_seller_business_infos.created_at. Immutable.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to business info record. Maps to shopping_seller_business_infos.updated_at.

IShoppingSellerBusinessInfo.IUpdate.description:
Update object for the legal and business registration, KYC, and compliance information of a seller. This DTO is used for FULL ATOMIC REPLACEMENT (all fields required) of business credentials, regulatory compliance, tax/KYC identity, customer support, and payout fields in seller onboarding and update flows. Values must meet platform validation for all fields. PATCH/partial updates are not allowed for compliance traceability. Each operation is audit-logged for KYC/AML obligations. The DTO is mapped directly to the shopping_seller_business_infos table. Changes to legal entity, registration number, or bank account may require additional verification by platform administrators. DO NOT pass null for required fields. Security: Only the owning seller or platform admins may use this DTO. See business onboarding and B2B/B2C regulatory documentation for jurisdictional nuances.

All string values must comply with local legal entity name, business registration number, and banking format/length constraints. The support_contact is published to buyers for returns or issues. Bank account information must be current and registered to the legal entity for settlement. All fields are stress-checked during onboarding and update flows. Edits to most fields may be escalated for manual admin review depending on risk scoring or regulatory alerts.

legal_entity_name.description: Full legal name for the seller (company or person) responsible for tax, regulatory, and compliance obligations. Must match official business registry documentation. Subject to validation against government databases during onboarding or audit. This field is REQUIRED and must be accurate for all jurisdictions.

registration_number.description: Business registration / tax identification number as issued by national or regional authority. Must be unique to the legal entity and supplied for all regulated marketplaces. Format, length, and uniqueness conform to platform business rules, and must pass jurisdictional validation for compliance. Regulatory audits and KYC screening mandate up-to-date registration here.

representative_name.description: Full name of the authorized legal representative (owner, CEO, president) as registered with governmental authorities. Used for KYC/AML checks and legal notifications. Must match supporting documentation (business registration, tax filings, etc).

support_contact.description: Public phone or email address published to buyers for returns, inquiries, or regulatory messaging. Must be current and reachable during all business hours. Platform will use this contact for order/status notifications and compliance messages. This is the merchant's business-facing support endpoint.

bank_account_number.description: Primary payout/settlement bank account number for remitting funds. Must be a valid account belonging to the legal entity. Format and length must follow country banking standards. Changing bank account triggers extra verification (may hold settlements until review). Subject to financial KYC/AML review per transaction volume or jurisdiction.

IShoppingSellerAddress.IRequest.description:
Request filter/query DTO for advanced listing of seller address records from the shopping_seller_addresses table. Enables address book management, returns/fulfillment logistics, and regulatory compliance screening for sellers and authorized admins. Each field allows for fine-grained selection, filtering, and sorting when searching a seller's saved addresses. All fields are optional; omitting all parameters returns the full address list for the seller. Used for GET or PATCH /shopping/(seller|admin)/sellers/{sellerId}/addresses endpoints.

Parameter meanings:
- is_primary: Boolean; if true, only primary/main addresses; if false or omitted, all addresses returned.
- is_return_address: Boolean; if true, only return/logistics endpoints for refunds/returns; if omitted, all address types.
- city/state/country: Strings for partial text match on city, regional/province/state, or country fields, enabling complex geographic queries or audits (case-insensitive, partials allowed).
- page: Integer; paginated results (1-based index, default 1 if omitted).
- limit: Integer; results per page (default system value; capped at business maximum).
- sort_by: String; determines which field is used to sort the results (e.g., 'updated_at' for recently changed addresses, 'city' for grouping geographically).
- sort_order: Enum ('asc' or 'desc'); changes the order of sorting, ascending or descending.

Pagination, filtering, and sorting must be combined in accordance with business and UI constraints. No address creation or update fields are included here. Security: Only the seller themselves or an authorized admin may use this query.

is_primary.description: If true, only returns the primary (main) address for this seller. If omitted or false, returns all addresses regardless of primary flag. Used to display, audit, or validate main business addresses for regulatory or notification purposes.

is_return_address.description: If true, returns only those addresses designated as return/refund endpoints, as required for order returns or customer communications. If omitted, includes all address types. Used in compliance workflows and for optimizing returns logistics.

city.description: Filters addresses with a partial or full match to the specified city value. Supports fuzzy/case-insensitive match. Useful for regionally-scoped address book audits or reporting. Optional.

state.description: Filters addresses by administrative region, province, or state. Accepts partial/substring matches for complex regions. Optional parameter for region-specific administrative management or reporting flows.

country.description: Limits results to addresses in the specified country (case-insensitive, text match). Optional. Used for country-based compliance and market segmentation reporting.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (must be integer >= 1). First page is 1 by convention.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page (capped at business maximum, e.g., 100). Defaults to system configured max if omitted.

sort_by.description: Field to sort address records by. Accepts platform-defined fields (e.g., 'updated_at', 'city', 'is_primary'). Sorting field MUST exist in the shopping_seller_addresses schema. Used to drive address listing UIs and export batches.

sort_order.description: Sort order/direction for the sorting field. Allowed values: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Must be paired to sort_by or ignores default backend sort.

IShoppingSellerAddress.description: Seller address entity used for business, return, and warehouse locations. Maps directly to the shopping_seller_addresses table, which stores multiple address types per seller for order fulfillment, returns, and compliance. Fields include primary/return address flags, address lines, city, state, postal code, country, contact phone, recipient name, and audit timestamps, as defined in the Prisma schema's detailed model comments. Used in address management workflows, seller profile, and shipping configuration.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID primary key) for this seller address. Maps to shopping_seller_addresses.id.

shopping_seller_id.description: Owning seller's id (shopping_sellers.id). Used as FK in address lookup and authorization contexts.

address_line1.description: Primary address string (e.g., street, building, apartment). Required for delivery and legal contact.

oneOf.description: Detail or secondary address information (optional suite/floor/extra details).

address_line2.description: Detail or secondary address information (optional suite/floor/extra details).

city.description: City or locality for the address (e.g., Seoul, Incheon, etc.).

state.description: State, province, or administrative region for the address.

postal_code.description: Postal code or ZIP code for this address.

country.description: Country name for the address (e.g., South Korea, United States, etc.).

is_return_address.description: True if this address is designated as a return address for goods refunds/returns.

is_primary.description: Indicates if this is the seller's primary/main address.

phone.description: Local business/contact phone for delivery or warehouse/branch pickup point.

recipient_name.description: Recipient's display name for delivery. Reflects either the business or individual receiving shipments at this address (e.g., warehouse manager, return processing coordinator, or shop operator). Required for logistics and fulfillment accuracy.

created_at.description: Timestamp for address record creation (audit trail).

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp for the address entry (audit).

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp (nullable); present if address is archived/deleted; null if active.

IShoppingSellerAddress.$comment: All properties, types, and required/optional/nullable/UUID/date-time formats are strictly based on the shopping_seller_addresses Prisma table structure and its detailed documentation. No additional logic fields are introduced.

IShoppingSellerAddress.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new seller address (business, primary, return, or warehouse). Matches the shopping_seller_addresses table and Create operation requirements. Does not include system-managed fields (id, shopping_seller_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). Used in POST /shopping/seller/sellers/{sellerId}/addresses and admin counterpart - sellerId comes from the path, so not in the body. All required fields are validated per business/prisma rules: address_line1, city, state, postal_code, country, recipient_name, phone, is_primary, is_return_address. address_line2 is optional. No actor ID or ownership allowed in request body; context is determined server-side by authentication and path.

oneOf.description: Detail/secondary address (suite, etc). Optional.

city.description: City or locality for the address. Required.

state.description: State, province, or region for the address. Required.

is_primary.description: True if this is the seller's main (primary) address. Required.

is_return_address.description: True if this is the designated return address for goods (refunds/returns). Required.

recipient_name.description: Recipient's display name for delivery. Reflects either the business or individual receiving shipments at this address (e.g., warehouse manager, return processing coordinator, or shop operator). Required for logistics and fulfillment accuracy.

IShoppingSellerAddress.IUpdate.description: DTO schema for updating a seller address. This structure is used in PATCH/PUT endpoints to modify existing address records. All fields are optional for partial updates. Only mutable address book fields are present—system-managed identifiers and timestamps are excluded. Null values for address_line2 explicitly clear the field (PATCH semantics). The mutually exclusive relationship of is_primary and is_return_address is enforced at business logic level, and only one can be true for a given address/seller at a time. Format and value constraints (length, allowed country, valid phone format) should mirror the creation DTO and entity, even if not explicitly repeated here. No extra properties allowed.

address_line1.description: Street address (main line) for the seller location. Required for delivery or warehouse identification; can be updated via this DTO.

oneOf.description: Second address line, such as apartment, suite, or additional details (nullable). Set null to remove any existing value.

address_line2.description: Second address line, such as apartment, suite, or additional details (nullable). Set null to remove any existing value.

city.description: City or locality for address. Updatable for all address types through this DTO.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address (compliant with country rules).

country.description: Country for the address (e.g., 'South Korea', 'United States').

is_return_address.description: Set to true if this address is to be used for product returns/refunds. Must be false if is_primary is true. Cannot be both true for the same address.

is_primary.description: Set to true if this address is the main/primary business address for the seller. Must be false if is_return_address is true. Only one address per seller may be primary.

phone.description: Contact phone number for this address/location. Should be valid for delivery logistics.

recipient_name.description: Recipient or contact name for this address entry. Used for shipments or site operations.

IShoppingSellerSession.IRequest.description: Filter and pagination DTO for requesting lists of seller authentication sessions associated with the shopping_seller_sessions table. Allows clients (seller or admin) to filter sessions by creation date ranges, expiration status, IP address, and href/referrer fields, as well as to page through results using common pagination fields.

page.description: The page of results to return, starting with 1 for the first page. Used for paging through large sets of session records.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (default and max subject to business constraints; typically 20-100).

created_after.description: (Optional) If provided, filter to sessions created after the specified ISO 8601 date string.

created_before.description: (Optional) If provided, filter to sessions created before the specified ISO 8601 date string.

expired.description: (Optional) If provided, filter sessions on their expiration status (true for expired, false for currently open sessions).

ip.description: (Optional) Filter by originating IP address. See shopping_seller_sessions.ip.

href.description: (Optional) Filter sessions by the URL at which the login/session was established. See shopping_seller_sessions.href.

referrer.description: (Optional) Filter by referrer URL provided at session start. See shopping_seller_sessions.referrer.

page.description:
Page number for pagination, starts from 1.
Typically used for paginated queries in admin listing endpoints.

limit.description: Number of results per page for pagination. Maximum and minimum values depend on business constraint policies, e.g., maximum 100 per request.

search.description: Keyword-based search filter, matches admin email, name, or role fields using LIKE, trigram, or full-text search.

role.description: Filter by administrative privilege role (e.g. 'super', 'support', 'compliance', 'operator'). Matches the `role` field in shopping_admins table.

status.description: Filter by admin business status (e.g. 'active', 'suspended', 'pending', 'locked'). Matches the `status` field in shopping_admins table.

order_by.description: Field name to sort query results by (e.g. 'created_at', 'name', 'email', 'role').

oneOf.description: Sort direction for the order_by field. Enum: 'asc', 'desc'.
Sort direction for the order_by field. Enum: 'asc', 'desc'.

order.description: Sort direction for the order_by field. Enum: 'asc', 'desc'.

IShoppingAdmin.IRequest.description: DTO for searching, filtering, and paginating administrator accounts in the platform. Allows super admins to find, review, and export admin data for RBAC, compliance, and security workflows. All fields correspond directly to search filters or sorting fields for the shopping_admins table. Does NOT include any direct authentication credentials, secrets, or sensitive fields.

id.description: Unique identifier for the admin entity. Exact mapping to id column in shopping_admins table.

email.description: Admin account login/email address. Guaranteed unique, used for authentication and notification. Maps to 'email' in shopping_admins.

name.description: Admin real name, used for audit/compliance, notification, and personal identification. Matches the 'name' column.

role.description: Privilege level for admin user (e.g. 'super', 'support', 'operator', 'compliance'). Values match 'role' in shopping_admins. Used for RBAC enforcement on all admin operations.

status.description: Administrative business status for account (e.g. 'active', 'suspended', 'pending', 'locked', etc). Enforces login, operation eligibility. Maps to 'status' field.

created_at.description: Timestamp the admin account was created. Maps exactly to 'created_at' in shopping_admins.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to the admin account (profile edit, role/status change, etc). Maps to 'updated_at'.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion marker for this admin. If not null, the account is logically deleted/disabled (per audit/compliance policy). Maps to 'deleted_at'.

IShoppingAdmin.description: Comprehensive administrator profile and status object as per shopping_admins table. Contains identity, contact, role, and compliance metadata for each admin. Password hash and authentication secrets are NEVER exposed. All properties correspond EXACTLY to columns in shopping_admins. For audit, privilege, and security dashboards.

email.description: Unique admin email for login and notifications. Updating this value changes the administrator's platform login credential. Must be globally unique across all admins; required for account identity and contact.

name.description: Human-readable full name of the admin for audit and communications. Used in logs, dashboard displays, and notifications.

role.description: Admin privilege level (such as 'super', 'support', etc). Used for RBAC policy enforcement and must conform to current platform role policy.

status.description: Admin account business status (active, suspended, pending, etc). Determines login and privilege eligibility.

IShoppingAdmin.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for administrator account in the shopping_admins table. May update contact details, name, privilege level (role), or status, except for password hashes (passwords are updated through a dedicated endpoint). Uniqueness of email is enforced. All fields are optional and may be supplied in any combination for updating profile attributes. Subject to platform RBAC and admin privilege escalation rules. Changes are always audit logged for compliance and traceability.

oneOf.description: Optional filter for session status. Use 'active' to search currently open (non-expired) sessions, 'expired' for ended sessions.
Optional filter for session status. Use 'active' to search currently open (non-expired) sessions, 'expired' for ended sessions.

status.description: Optional filter for session status. Use 'active' to search currently open (non-expired) sessions, 'expired' for ended sessions.

ip.description: Optional filter on originating IP address for session records. Supports partial matching to enable searching for a subnet or specific address.

login_time_from.description: (Optional) Restrict results to sessions with creation (login) time after or on this value (inclusive). Must be in ISO 8601 format.

login_time_to.description: (Optional) Restrict results to sessions with creation (login) time before or on this value (inclusive). Must be in ISO 8601 format.

oneOf.description: Session ordering criterion. Choose created_at for most recent logins or expired_at for last-closed sessions.
Session ordering criterion. Choose created_at for most recent logins or expired_at for last-closed sessions.

order_by.description: Session ordering criterion. Choose created_at for most recent logins or expired_at for last-closed sessions.

oneOf.description: Sort direction for results: ascending or descending by the 'order_by' field.
Sort direction for results: ascending or descending by the 'order_by' field.

order_direction.description: Sort direction for results: ascending or descending by the 'order_by' field.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Must be >= 1. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

limit.description: Maximum records per page. Defaults to 20; must not exceed 100 in a request.

IShoppingAdminSession.IRequest.description: Request DTO for filtering, searching, and paginating administrator session records from shopping_admin_sessions. Allows querying by session status, IP, login/expiration times, and result ordering. Used for administrative session audits and compliance review. Pagination is mandatory; page and limit must always be set. Additional criteria help restrict/sort session records as needed for operational or security investigation.

page.description: Page index for pagination. Indicates the current page to retrieve when listing user email entries. Must be positive. Example: 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of user email records to return per page in a paginated listing. Typical default is 20; maximum as allowed by backend policy. Example: 50.

search.description: Free-text search term used for filtering user email entries by partial match on the email address, regardless of owner type (customer or seller). Case-insensitive, optional.

customer_id.description: Optional filter to restrict results to those belonging to a specific customer account (shopping_customers.id). Only one actor filter can be applied at a time. Mutually exclusive with 'seller_id'—do not set both.

seller_id.description: Optional filter to restrict results to user emails belonging to a particular seller (shopping_sellers.id). Only one actor filter can be applied at a time. Mutually exclusive with 'customer_id'—do not set both.

is_verified.description: Boolean filter to select only verified or unverified email addresses. If null or unspecified, all records are included regardless of verification state.

is_primary.description: Boolean filter to select only primary or non-primary email addresses for the user. If null or unspecified, all primary and secondary records are included.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort the user email results. Acceptable values: 'email', 'created_at', 'updated_at'.
Field by which to sort the user email results. Acceptable values: 'email', 'created_at', 'updated_at'.
Field by which to sort the user email results. Acceptable values: 'email', 'created_at', 'updated_at'.

order_by.description: Field by which to sort the user email results. Acceptable values: 'email', 'created_at', 'updated_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort direction. Can be 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if unspecified.
Sort direction. Can be 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if unspecified.

order.description: Sort direction. Can be 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if unspecified.

IShoppingUserEmail.IRequest.description: Search, filter, and pagination criteria for paginated user email address listing. Fields are applied as query parameters to the shopping_user_emails index operation. Note: 'customer_id' and 'seller_id' are mutually exclusive—specify only one per request for correct filter logic.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier of the user email entry in the shopping_user_emails table.

oneOf.description: Foreign key referencing the shopping_customers.id if this email is associated to a customer. Only one actor owner is set per record.

shopping_customer_id.description: Foreign key referencing the shopping_customers.id if this email is associated to a customer. Only one actor owner is set per record. Only one of 'shopping_customer_id' or 'shopping_seller_id' will be present (non-null); the other will always be null, indicating actor ownership.

oneOf.description: Foreign key referencing the shopping_sellers.id if this email is associated to a seller. Only one actor owner is set per record.

shopping_seller_id.description: Foreign key referencing the shopping_sellers.id if this email is associated to a seller. Only one actor owner is set per record. Only one of 'shopping_customer_id' or 'shopping_seller_id' will be present (non-null); the other will always be null, indicating actor ownership.

email.description: Email address value, used for login, recovery, or notifications. Unique per system. May be pending, secondary, historical, or unverified.

is_verified.description: Indicates whether this email has been verified via user action or system workflow. Used for authentication and permission enforcement.

is_primary.description: True if this email is the current primary login email for the owner. Should only be true for one entry per actor account.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this user email entry was created/added. Used for audit and chronological ordering.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this user email entry was last updated (e.g., change of verification or primary status).

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the email entry was removed from account but retained for audit. Null if active.

IShoppingUserEmail.description: Represents a secondary, pending, or historical email record associated with either a customer or seller. Used for account contact, recovery workflows, audit history, and managing primary email designation. Maps directly to the shopping_user_emails Prisma table. Actor association is via shopping_customer_id or shopping_seller_id. Exactly one of these (not both) is set for each record.

IShoppingUserEmail.IUpdate.description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) for updating an existing user email record in the shopping platform. This object allows modification of properties for a given user email identified by ID, such as changing the email address, toggling verification status, or designating the record as the new primary email. Only fields defined in the Prisma shopping_user_emails table are accepted. Usage examples include user correction of a secondary email, administrative email updates, or primary designation change. All updates must comply with business rules (unique email constraint, only one primary per user, verified status integrity). Attempts to update fields outside these allowed or not present in the Prisma schema will be rejected. All properties are optional to support PATCH-like semantics, but at least one property should be provided on each valid request. System-managed and forbidden fields (id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) are excluded.

email.description: Secondary, pending, or historical email address for the user. Must be unique within the platform and follow email standards. Changing this value to a duplicate of another record will violate unique constraint. Verified by user action before elevation to primary.

is_verified.description: Indicates if this email address has been verified by the user's action. True means the email has completed verification via workflow (e.g., email link). Only verified emails can become primary.

is_primary.description: Marks whether this is the user's primary login/notification email. Only one user email per account (customer or seller) can have is_primary=true at a time.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for the most recent update to this email record. Typically set by the system on modification, but may be patched for audit tracking. Format is ISO 8601 date-time.

IShoppingPasswordReset.IRequest.description: DTO for administrative search, filter, and pagination of password reset requests within the shopping platform (shopping_password_resets table). Used for listing and auditing all password reset attempts across customers, sellers, and admins. Contains options for text search, filtering by actor type (customer, seller, admin), date range filtering, token/status filtering, and cursor-based pagination. At least one filter, sort, or search option should be supplied for meaningful queries. Returned records are summaries from the password reset history for audit and investigation purposes.

page.description: Page number to retrieve for pagination, where 1 means the first page. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (pagination). System-enforced maximum is 100.

search.description: Search substring or partial match for filtering requests by email address or actor name. Case-insensitive, supports partial word matches.

oneOf.description: Filter for password reset requests by actor class: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'.
Filter for password reset requests by actor class: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'.
Filter for password reset requests by actor class: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'.

actor_type.description: Filter for password reset requests by actor class: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'.

oneOf.description: Filter requests by reset token status. 'pending' for unconsumed, 'expired' for tokens past expires_at, or 'used' for requests where consumed_at is set.
Filter requests by reset token status. 'pending' for unconsumed, 'expired' for tokens past expires_at, or 'used' for requests where consumed_at is set.
Filter requests by reset token status. 'pending' for unconsumed, 'expired' for tokens past expires_at, or 'used' for requests where consumed_at is set.

status.description: Filter requests by reset token status. 'pending' for unconsumed, 'expired' for tokens past expires_at, or 'used' for requests where consumed_at is set.

created_from.description: ISO 8601 date-time to filter password reset requests created after this point (inclusive).

created_to.description: ISO 8601 date-time to filter password reset requests created before this point (inclusive).

expires_from.description: ISO 8601 date-time to include only requests whose token expires at or after this instant.

expires_to.description: ISO 8601 date-time to include only requests whose token expires at or before this instant.

oneOf.description: Field to sort results by; allowed values are 'created_at' or 'expires_at'. Default typically is 'created_at'.
Field to sort results by; allowed values are 'created_at' or 'expires_at'. Default typically is 'created_at'.

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by; allowed values are 'created_at' or 'expires_at'. Default typically is 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending. Default is 'desc' (most recent first).
Sort direction: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending. Default is 'desc' (most recent first).

sort_order.description: Sort direction: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending. Default is 'desc' (most recent first).

consumed.description: If true, only include password resets that have been used/consumed; if false, only those still active/pending (not yet used).

email.description: Filter for requests by exact email address (case-insensitive).

IShoppingPasswordReset.description:
Represents a single password reset request for any actor (customer, seller, or admin). This entity is used for secure authentication recovery and audit tracing. Every reset request is uniquely identified and stores the request email, reset code, association to the relevant actor (customer, seller, or admin), expiration, consumption audit, and full traceability. Security controls ensure that the reset_code field is only returned to privileged endpoints. Designed to be fully auditable as required by business, compliance, and support workflows.

This schema directly reflects the Prisma `shopping_password_resets` model. All fields are faithfully represented, supporting both read-only administrative usage and sensitive workflows such as password recovery security audits, expiration, and override operations. For field-by-field information, see detailed descriptions of each property below.

id.description: Primary Key. System-generated UUID uniquely identifying the password reset request.

oneOf.description: If this request targets a customer, this is the customer's id. Nullable.

shopping_customer_id.description: Customer id who owns this password reset request. References shopping_customers.id. Nullable; exactly one of shopping_customer_id, shopping_seller_id, or shopping_admin_id will be set depending on actor.

oneOf.description: If this request targets a seller, this is the seller's id. Nullable.

shopping_seller_id.description: Seller id who owns this password reset request. References shopping_sellers.id. Nullable; exactly one of shopping_customer_id, shopping_seller_id, or shopping_admin_id will be set depending on actor.

oneOf.description: If this request targets an admin, this is the admin's id. Nullable.

shopping_admin_id.description: Admin id who owns this password reset request. References shopping_admins.id. Nullable; exactly one of shopping_customer_id, shopping_seller_id, or shopping_admin_id will be set depending on actor.

request_email.description: Email address to which this password reset request was made. Used for lookup and notification audit. References both actor and system context.

reset_code.description: Secure reset code/token associated with this password reset request. Always returned hashed or masked except for processes which require it (never as plaintext). Must be unique and cryptographically generated.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp (UTC) for the validity of this reset code. After this time the code is invalid.

oneOf.description: If this reset code has been used, the timestamp it was consumed.

consumed_at.description: Timestamp at which the password reset code was used or invalidated. If null, the reset is still active or expired.

created_at.description: Request creation timestamp for trace and audit.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of most recent update to the reset record (e.g., expiry refresh or usage event).

IShoppingPasswordReset.IUpdate.description:
Request body type for updating a password reset request's audit or security fields in the shopping mall platform. Used to mark a reset as consumed, extend its validity, or administratively update security-summary fields. Does NOT permit changes to system-generated identifiers or reset_code. Only expiry, consumption, or audit details may be changed. Follows strict security controls enforced by authorization context (actor must own the request or be platform admin).

This schema reflects a subset of properties in Prisma model shopping_password_resets. Only updatable fields are included; identifiers such as id, reset_code, and actor ids are not modifiable through this DTO.

expires_at.description: Optional: New expiration timestamp (UTC) for this password reset, to extend or retroactively expire the request. Required for explicit expiry update, but optional for usage update.

oneOf.description: Timestamp when the reset was used or administratively marked consumed.

consumed_at.description: Optional: Timestamp to mark the reset as consumed or invalidate the request. If not specified in the update, keeps current value.

page.description: The page number for paginated product search results. Default is 1. This controls which zero-based set of results is returned in paginated queries.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to include per page of results. Default is 20, maximum is 100. Used for API page-size control.

keyword.description: Optional keyword for searching product name and description in wildcard/full-text catalog queries.

code.description: Exact filter for the unique product code in catalog. Used for direct lookup or business reporting.

seller_id.description: Filter products by specific seller's UUID (shopping_sellers.id). Seller-side queries for own products use this, as do admin-level overviews.

status.description: Filter for product status (e.g., 'active', 'draft', 'archived', 'under_review'). Accepts explicit status codes defined in shopping_products.status.

business_status.description: Filter for detailed product workflow status (such as 'approved', 'pending', 'rejected') per workflow policy.

category_id.description: Filter to include only products assigned to a specific category. (References shopping_categories.id, must be a leaf node).

category_code.description: Filter for products assigned to category via unique business code (shopping_categories.category_code).

tag_code.description: Filter for products with assigned tag business code (shopping_product_tags.tag_code).

min_price.description: Minimum price filter (inclusive) for product list result. Controls the lower bound for catalog price facets.

max_price.description: Maximum price filter (inclusive) for product catalog result. Enables price range filtering.

sku_code.description: Filter products (or variants) by exact SKU code (shopping_skus.sku_code), supporting direct SKU-based queries.

attribute_dimension_code.description: Filter for assigned attribute dimension (variant type, e.g., 'color', 'size'). Must match shopping_attribute_dimensions.dimension_code.

attribute_value_code.description: Filter for products with specific attribute value (e.g., 'red', 'XL'). Must match shopping_attribute_values.value_code.

IShoppingProduct.IRequest.description: Request body DTO for searching, filtering, and paginating catalog products in the shopping_products table. Accepts search keywords, field-based filters (code, status, seller, category, tags, price), variant and attribute options, and full catalog sorting. Used in PATCH /shopping/products for catalog and admin search APIs. Does not allow hidden/internal field queries. All fields are optional except for pagination (page, limit).

id.description: Primary key for the product (shopping_products.id).

shopping_seller_id.description: UUID reference to the owning seller (shopping_sellers.id).

code.description: Unique business code for the product, used for business-side lookup and external integrations (shopping_products.code, unique).

name.description: Display name of the product; used as the main catalog title (shopping_products.name).

description.description: Long product description shown in catalog and detail pages (shopping_products.description).

main_image_uri.description: URI/URL to the product's primary display image (shopping_products.main_image_uri). Can be null if not set.

status.description: Business workflow/catalog status for this product (e.g., 'active', 'draft', 'archived', 'under_review'). (shopping_products.status).

business_status.description: Detailed product workflow or compliance status. Used for review/approval processing. (shopping_products.business_status).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the product entity was first created (shopping_products.created_at).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when product detail was most recently updated (shopping_products.updated_at).

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for soft deletion/archival. Null if the product is active. (shopping_products.deleted_at).

seller.description: Owning seller's summary information, transformed from shopping_seller_id. Contains only essential public fields for catalog display and management.

categories.description: Product category assignments. Each item references a category assigned to the product. Null/empty array if not assigned. Only leaf categories included.

skus.description: Array of SKUs/variants directly under this product. Each element represents a unique sellable variant (e.g., with unique price/attribute combination).

images.description: List of image assets for this product, ordered for display. Populated from shopping_product_images (max 10 per product in business logic).

tags.description: List of tags assigned to the product for filtering and search, mapped via shopping_product_tags.

attributes.description: Product-level attribute assignments and their values, for attribute-based faceted search and filtering.

IShoppingProduct.description: Detail type definition for the shopping_products entity. Contains all main product information fields (id, code, name, description, image, status/state, timestamps) plus related seller, categories, images, SKUs, tags, and attributes. Follows atomic operation rule: provides a complete catalog view with all business/public details for a product. Excludes internal fields (passwords, cost, audit info). Relationship fields use summary views (e.g., seller) to prevent circular ref. Used in product detail APIs.

IShoppingSeller.ISummary.description:
Minimal summary of seller information for use in refund/item context and other references. Includes display name, unique identifier, and account status for business context and compliance. The 'status' field reflects the account lifecycle (pending, active, suspended, rejected), matching critical business requirements.

For display purposes only (e.g., show in order line or product summary).

id.description: UUID for seller (shopping_sellers.id).

status.description: Seller account status (pending, active, suspended, rejected). Reflects the lifecycle and eligibility of seller operations on the platform, determined by onboarding, verification, suspension, or compliance actions. Sourced from shopping_sellers.status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the category. Prisma: 'id'.

category_name.description: Display name for this category node. Prisma: 'category_name'.

IShoppingCategory.ISummary.description: Summary or reference type for a single category node in the catalog hierarchy. Used for embedding minimal category information in navigation, filter, or product APIs. Only leaf categories are valid for product assignment or selection operations; this summary is always used to represent those assignments or list/filter options. This type is suitable for light-weight embedding in product, search, and listing contexts, and does not contain any recursive hierarchy or parent/child references. For complete tree navigation, use the full category DTO. Enforces platform constraints by only returning recognized leaf categories as valid target references, according to business rule documentation and product onboarding flows.

id.description: UUID identifier for this product image (matches shopping_product_images.id).

shopping_product_id.description: UUID of the parent product owning this image.

image_uri.description: URI string of the product image file as stored (required, JPEG or PNG).

order_index.description: Order index (zero-based) for display sorting. Optional.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 upload/creation timestamp.

IShoppingProductImage.description: Product image entity. Image linked to a product, including URI/location and metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for this product tag record. UUID string as assigned in shopping_product_tags.id. Used in search/filter and tag management APIs.

tag_code.description: Business code/slug uniquely representing the product tag (e.g., 'eco', 'vegan'). Used for API/URL/addressable reference. Expects lowercase, hyphen/underscore-separated token. Example: 'organic-cotton'.

display_value.description: Business/UI-facing display name for this tag (as seen by users in catalog search, filters, or product page). Example: 'Eco-Friendly', 'Premium', 'Handmade'.

IShoppingTag.ISummary.description: Summary information for a single tag applied to products in search/filter/labeling interfaces. Tags are business-created labels (see shopping_product_tags) attached to products for enhanced catalog filtering, user search, and administrative curation. Used in product summary responses, tag cloud displays, and as filter options in product list APIs. Each object exposes the unique tag identifier, canonical code for API/analytics, and display value for UI/business context. Example: tag_code 'vegan', display_value 'Vegan Friendly'.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for this product-level attribute assignment. References shopping_product_attributes.id. Used to reference and manage this mapping in API/admin UIs.

attribute_dimension.description: Reference to the attribute dimension for this mapping (e.g., Color, Size, Material). This field indicates which attribute type (such as color or size) is being assigned to a product. Example: { id: '...', dimension_code: 'color', name: 'Color' }.

attribute_value.description: Reference to the concrete attribute value (e.g., 'Red', 'Large', 'Cotton') associated with the dimension. Indicates which value from the dimension is mapped to the product. This is used for catalog filtering and variant exposition.

IShoppingProductAttribute.description: Single product-level assignment mapping a specific attribute value (e.g., 'Red' or 'XL') within a given dimension (e.g., 'Color' or 'Size') to a product. Used for catalog faceted filtering, display in product detail, and search APIs for allowing customers to filter/navigate products by attribute options. Each record represents the relationship of a product to one attribute/value pair — for example, 'T-shirt' product assigned both Color=Red and Size=L via separate mappings of this type. The object exposes the attribute_dimension and attribute_value in summary reference (not full detail), for UI filter/selection and admin validation.

IShoppingAttributeDimension.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for shopping attribute dimensions. This schema provides a compact representation of an attribute dimension (e.g., Color, Size) for use in search/filter UIs, product listing displays, and reference arrays where only key identification and display information is needed. The fields are mapped directly from the shopping_attribute_dimensions Prisma model, retaining all business identifiers necessary for reference and UI integration. Used primarily for lists of dimensions, references on variants, and filter contexts. No composition or downward relations included in summary types.

- The dimension_code field uniquely identifies this attribute type (business key and used in query/filters).
- The name is the display (user-facing) label; description gives context for UI documentation. This type does not embed the attribute values themselves—use the detail DTO for that.
- This summary is lightweight by design, intended for reference, suggestion, and minimal join operations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the attribute dimension (PK, UUID).

dimension_code.description: Business code for this attribute dimension (e.g., 'color', 'size'). Uniquely identifies the dimension for filtering and queries. Matches Prisma's dimension_code field.

name.description: Display name for the attribute dimension (e.g., 'Color', 'Size'). Matches Prisma name column.

oneOf.description: Long description of the dimension's purpose for documentation or UI help. Optional. Maps to Prisma description.

description.description: Long description of the dimension's purpose for documentation or UI help. Optional. Maps to Prisma description.

id.description: Unique identifier. Prisma: 'id'.

value_code.description: Unique code for this attribute value within the dimension. Prisma: 'value_code'.

display_value.description: Display string for the attribute value. Prisma: 'display_value'.

dimension.description: Attribute dimension this value belongs to (e.g. Color, Size).

IShoppingAttributeValue.ISummary.description: Summary DTO for attribute value selection, filtering, and SKU variant representation.

IShoppingProduct.ICreate.description:
DTO for creating a new product (shopping_products) in the catalog. This schema includes all fields required by onboarding business requirements; core catalog identity, display basics, main image, status, and essential product shipping metadata for onboarding.

Properties:
- code: Unique product code (business key, required)
- name: Product display name (required)
- description: Long description for catalog/search (required)
- main_image_uri: URI to the primary display image (JPEG/PNG, required)
- status: Workflow/catalog status (draft, active, archived, under_review)
- business_status: Detailed business onboarding/workflow status (e.g., in_review, approved, rejected)
- shipping_weight_grams: Shipping weight in grams (for logistics, optional)
- shipping_length_cm: Shipping length (centimeters, optional)
- shipping_width_cm: Shipping width (centimeters, optional)
- shipping_height_cm: Shipping height (centimeters, optional)
- shipping_options: Shipping method/rules as text (optional, may be used for selection/logic)

All fields are defined according to the Prisma schema or extracted from required onboarding business requirements. Actual shipping constraints are enforced by business logic; all values must be present before product can be published.

code.description: Unique business code for the product, used for lookup or external referencing. This must be unique within the system, and is used to identify the product in business workflows. (Corresponds to shopping_products.code)

name.description: Product display name shown to shoppers. Used for search and catalog display. Required for all products. (Corresponds to shopping_products.name)

description.description: Long description of the product for customer information and search indexing. (Corresponds to shopping_products.description)

main_image_uri.description: URI to the primary display image associated with this product. JPEG or PNG, up to 5MB per business rules. Required at product creation (Corresponds to shopping_products.main_image_uri)

status.description: Product status (e.g., draft, active, archived, under_review). Used in workflow. Must conform to platform product lifecycle states. (Corresponds to shopping_products.status)

business_status.description: Business workflow status (e.g., in_review, approved, rejected). Used for workflow and lifecycle control. (Corresponds to shopping_products.business_status)

shipping_weight_grams.description: Shipping weight for this product (grams). Required for shipping calculation. Optional at creation but must be provided before product publishing.

shipping_length_cm.description: Shipping length (cm). Optional at creation, required by fulfillment before activation.

shipping_width_cm.description: Shipping width (cm). Optional at creation, required by fulfillment before activation.

shipping_height_cm.description: Shipping height (cm). Optional at creation, required by fulfillment before activation.

shipping_options.description: Shipping options or profile for this product in free-text or serialized form (may represent available carriers, ship-from, etc).

IShoppingProduct.IUpdate.description: DTO for updating an existing product (shopping_products) in the catalog. Only updatable business fields allowed. Account, seller, and product code are immutable and injected from path/auth context. Fields are all optional—provide the fields to update, omit others. Attempts to change code or seller will cause failure.

name.description: Product display name shown to shoppers. Can be updated unless business constraints apply. (shopping_products.name)

description.description: Long description of the product for customer information and search indexing. Can be updated by product owners. (shopping_products.description)

main_image_uri.description: URI to the primary display image for the product. In update flows, allows changing the representative image. (shopping_products.main_image_uri)

status.description: Product status (e.g., draft, active, archived, under_review). Controls visibility and lifecycle stages. (shopping_products.status)

business_status.description: Business workflow status for product review/approval. Can be changed by certain actors/admins. (shopping_products.business_status)

IShoppingSkuVariant.description: Represents a variant attribute value for a SKU (e.g., color: Red, size: L). Maps to a row in the shopping_sku_variants table. Used for composition in the SKU detail view.

id.description: Variant assignment PK.

shopping_attribute_value_id.description: FK to attribute value (color, size, etc).

attribute_value.description: The attribute value (summary: code, value, dimension).

shopping_attribute_dimension_id.description: Foreign key referencing the parent attribute dimension (shopping_attribute_dimensions.id), identifying the context for this value.

value_code.description: Globally unique code for this attribute value within its parent dimension, e.g., 'red', 'large', or 'cotton'. Used for API lookups, uniqueness validation, and catalog/variant mapping. Corresponds to shopping_attribute_values.value_code.

display_value.description: Human-readable label for this attribute value (e.g., 'Red', 'Large', 'Cotton'). Displayed to shoppers, sellers, and admins in all SKU and catalog variant/selection UIs. Corresponds to shopping_attribute_values.display_value.

oneOf.description: Ordering index among sibling attribute values under the same dimension. Used for sorting and controlled display in UI selectors.

display_order.description: Ordering index among sibling attribute values under the same dimension. Used for sorting and controlled display in UI selectors. Optional; may be null if display order is system/default or not managed.

oneOf.description: Optional extended description or admin/business context for the attribute value. Provides onboarding rationale, usage instructions, or other catalog documentation as needed. Maps to shopping_attribute_values.description in Prisma.

IShoppingAttributeValue.description: Represents a selectable value for a variant attribute (e.g., Color: Red, Size: Large) in the shopping mall platform. Attribute values are grouped under an attribute dimension (such as Color or Size) and enable flexible SKU and product catalog management. Fields directly match the shopping_attribute_values Prisma model. Includes optional, catalog-contextual description for completeness and round-trip documentation alignment.

id.description: Unique identifier for this attribute dimension. Generated by the system. Matches the 'id' column in the Prisma schema.

dimension_code.description: Globally unique business code for the attribute dimension (e.g. 'color', 'size', 'material'). Used by onboarding and catalog flows. See 'dimension_code' in the schema. (Required for all references.)

name.description: Human-readable display name for this dimension, such as 'Color', 'Size', or 'Material'. Used in product onboarding and for catalog UI. Sourced from the 'name' column.

description.description: Long-form business or operational description of what this attribute dimension represents. Used for onboarding, admin context, and audit history. Sourced from Prisma 'description'.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the attribute dimension was created. ISO 8601 format, UTC. Maps to Prisma 'created_at' field.

IShoppingAttributeDimension.description: Complete business entity for a product attribute dimension (e.g. Color, Size, Material). Used in catalog product variant management, onboarding, and admin flows. Each dimension defines a type of selectable variant for SKUs and product setup. Fields correspond to Prisma shopping_attribute_dimensions. Does not expose internal or system-only fields; intended for business logic and user flows only.

IShoppingProduct.ISummary.description: Summary DTO for a product, specifically optimized for display in product lists, cart, wishlist, and checkout UI contexts. Contains only minimal, highly relevant identifying properties: id, product code, user-facing name, and main image URI—used for rapid catalog rendering, selection, and transaction references. It intentionally omits all internal, seller, or audit fields. While 'main_image_uri' is formally optional, API implementations should best-effort include it whenever possible, as it enables proper display of product visuals in most business contexts. Absence of 'main_image_uri' should trigger placeholder assets in UI, not omission of product from the visual list.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product, as defined in the 'shopping_products.id' database field. Used as the primary business reference in all APIs and UI embedding.

code.description: Unique business code for this product (SKU root), referencing the 'shopping_products.code' field. Used for catalog and merchant management.

name.description: Product display name, from the 'shopping_products.name', for use in all product-listing and transaction contexts.

oneOf.description: URL to the product's main image as stored, for display as thumbnail or preview in list and cart contexts. Sourced from 'shopping_products.main_image_uri'. While this field is not formally required (may be null/absent), all API clients should expect best-effort inclusion for proper UI representation of the product in visual contexts. If absent, UI should substitute a default placeholder image for the product.

main_image_uri.description: URL to the product's main image as stored, for display as thumbnail or preview in list and cart contexts. Sourced from 'shopping_products.main_image_uri'. While this field is not formally required (may be null/absent), all API clients should expect best-effort inclusion for proper UI representation of the product in visual contexts. If absent, UI should substitute a default placeholder image for the product.

status.description: Current status of the product (e.g. 'active', 'draft', 'archived', etc). Sourced from 'shopping_products.status'. Always required for API clients to determine filtering, purchase eligibility, or product visibility.

search.description: Full-text search query to partially match the dimension_code, name, or description fields of attribute dimensions. Supports business onboarding and admin/seller variant setup flows. Example: 'color' or 'size'.

dimension_code.description: Filter for attribute dimensions by their globally unique business code. Allows precise lookup. Case-insensitive. Example: 'color', 'size', 'material'.

name.description: Filter for attribute dimensions by display name with partial match capability. Useful for admin/seller setup and audit.

created_from.description: Return only attribute dimensions created after this timestamp (inclusive). ISO 8601 format. For onboarding/audit use cases.

created_to.description: Return only attribute dimensions created before this timestamp (inclusive). ISO 8601 format. For onboarding/audit use cases.

Sort order for the sort_by field. Valid values: 'asc' (ascending), 'desc' (descending).

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Default is 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Default is 20, max is 100.

IShoppingAttributeDimension.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching and filtering product attribute dimensions in the catalog. Includes full-text search, field-specific filters, date range filtering, sorting, and paging controls. Used by admin/seller endpoints to enable product variant onboarding and management. Does not require authentication context fields.

IShoppingAttributeDimension.ICreate.description: DTO for creating a new product attribute dimension in the shopping platform catalog. This corresponds to the shopping_attribute_dimensions Prisma model, which defines selectable variant types (e.g., Color, Size, Material) for SKUs. Creation is reserved for admin or sellers with catalog privileges. All required properties must be provided and are globally unique within their business context. Upon creation, these dimensions become available for variant value assignment and catalog filtering.

dimension_code.description: Unique business code for the attribute dimension (e.g., 'color', 'size', 'material'). Must be globally unique within the catalog. Used for variant management, filtering, and product onboarding. This is immutable after creation, and is case-sensitive.

name.description: Display name for the attribute dimension, presented to users in product creation and search UIs (e.g., 'Color', 'Size'). Must be meaningful for sellers and buyers.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the attribute dimension's business purpose and use. Must provide context for sellers/admin understanding, shown in admin UIs and documentation.

IShoppingAttributeDimension.IUpdate.description: DTO for updating the display name and description of an existing attribute dimension, identified by its dimension_code. This type does NOT allow changing or editing the dimension_code, which is immutable for product and SKU assignment safety. Only the name and description fields are mutable. Used for platform catalog maintenance or business context update by admins/sellers.

name.description: New display name for the attribute dimension, presented in UI and catalogs. Changing this affects how the dimension appears in all product onboarding and selection interfaces.

description.description: Business context or detailed description for this dimension. May be changed to reflect updated purpose or business rules.

dimension_code.description: Unique code of the attribute dimension (e.g., COLOR, SIZE, MATERIAL). Must match the shopping_attribute_dimensions.dimension_code. Used for API path context and filtering.

search.description: Full-text search value for filtering attribute values by code or display value. Enables client to match partial or complete value labels.
